This is an antique/design object: a shower door designed by Le Corbusier for the Maison du Brésil (built 1959). It would be over 20 years old, but under 100 years, so it is not an antique under 9706. The item could be classified as a collector's piece under 9705, but it is a functional architectural element. Aluminum doors fall under 7610.10 ("Doors, windows and their frames and thresholds for doors"), and the HTS code is 7610.10.0010 or 7610.10.0090. The 7610.10.00 subheading has statistical suffixes: 7610.10.0010 is "Doors," and 7610.10.0020 is "Windows and their frames". I believe 7610.10.0010 is for doors, so I chose that.
